cues.en: Now our model got 100% on the training data, but only got 75% accuracy on the test data, which actually still pretty good.
cues.zh: 模型在訓練資料得到 100%，在測試資料只有 75% 準確率，不過其實還不錯。

cues.en: A coin toss for zero one would be 50%, so our models are halfway to being the perfect model.
cues.zh: 對 0 與 1 擲硬幣猜測，會是 50%，所以模型已經走到完美表現的一半路程。

cues.en: And then we go here, we try a few more classification metrics, so we got a little bit more of an insight rather than just accuracy.
cues.zh: 接著又試了幾種分類指標，所以除了準確率之外，也有更多了解。

cues.en: We did a confusion matrix and use the accuracy score function.
cues.zh: 做了混淆矩陣，並使用 accuracy_score 函式。

cues.en: And then step five, we tried a bunch of different hyper parameters a.k.a different estimators.
cues.zh: 第五步，嘗試了一些不同的超參數，也就是不同的估計器數量。

cues.en: We found out that maybe 20 estimators is the best for our model because they've got the highest accuracy.
cues.zh: 發現或許二十個估計器最適合這個模型，因為準確率最高。

cues.en: And then finally we saved a model and reloaded it, and it got the same score as our most recently trained model, which was 90 estimated, 73.77.
cues.zh: 最後儲存模型，再重新載入，得到和最近一次訓練相同的分數，也就是九十個估計器，73.77。

cues.en: And now this is a whole lot to take in.
cues.zh: 這裡的資訊量很大。

cues.en: I completely understand that we've gone through it relatively or actually quite fast, but what we're going to do is break down each of these steps throughout the next few videos.
cues.zh: 我完全了解，剛才速度相當快，甚至非常快。不過，接下來幾支影片，會把這些步驟逐一拆解。

cues.en: So if you want to go back through, try and put all the code that we've used into one cell if you can, and see if you can get a model trained, can you get it saved?
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以回頭試著把所有程式碼放進同一個儲存格，看看能不能訓練模型，能不能儲存它。

cues.en: Can you get re-import, have a little practise, but otherwise I'll see you in the next video and we're going to check out how to get our data ready for using it with machine learning models.
cues.zh: 能不能重新匯入？自己練習一下。那麼，下一支影片見，接下來會看看如何準備資料，讓它能用於機器學習模型。
